parameters.jsonBody:
={{ { model: 'gpt-4o-mini', response_format: { type: 'json_object' }, messages: [{ role: 'system', content: 'Moderate and normalize marketplace listings. Return JSON only with is_valid boolean, cleaned_title, cleaned_description, tags array, rejection_reason.' }, { role: 'user', content: `Title: ${$json.title}
Description: ${$json.description}` }] } }}

={{ { points: [{ id: $json.listingId, vector: $json.vector, payload: { listing_id: $json.listingId, title: $json.cleaned_title || $json.title, description: $json.cleaned_description || $json.description, price: Number($json.price), currency: $json.currency, category_id: $json.categoryId, location_id: $json.locationId, tags: $json.tags, status: $json.is_valid ? 'published' : 'rejected', created_at: new Date().toISOString() } }] } }}

={{ { listingId: $json.listingId, isValid: $json.is_valid === true, cleanedTitle: $json.cleaned_title, cleanedDescription: $json.cleaned_description, tags: $json.tags || [], rejectionReason: $json.rejection_reason || null } }}
